dct_title_s: Damage assessment in Bucas Grande Island, Socorro, Surigao del Norte of Philippines as of 17 December 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20211216PHL** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Bucas Grande Island, Socorro, Surigao del Norte of Philippines as detected by WorldView-3 image acquired on 17 December 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 351 damaged structures, 129 potentially damaged structures, 5 road obstacles and 1 destroyed bridge. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
